title: HandoverLab: system-level handover simulator for 5G-Advanced and beyond-5G research
description: HandoverLab is an open-source, system-level simulator of 3GPP mobility procedures (baseline handover with Event A3, Release-16 conditional and DAPS handover, Release-18 L1/L2-triggered mobility, conditional handover with the location events of Release 18) for many users in dense 5G-Advanced and beyond-5G networks, on a street grid, in an open area, along a highway, in an indoor office, in rural macro cells or under the earth-moving beams of a LEO satellite. It provides a TR 38.901 received-power radio model (TR 38.811 for the satellite), an L3-filtered measurement chain, a radio-link failure model, an outcome label for every handover attempt, a plug-in interface for handover rules, equal-budget tuning studies with paired statistics, and verification against hand-computed values, golden event-log fingerprints and ns-3 / 5G-LENA.
